# Express Pro Cleaning Services

> Family-owned cleaning services in Sacramento and surrounding areas. Home of the original Express Mini Blind & Window Cleaning. Serving Sacramento since 1989; family-owned since 1998.

## Business Information
- Business: Express Pro Cleaning Services
- Location: Sacramento, CA (service radius about 30 miles)
- Phone: (916) 983-9274 (call or text)
- Email: expressprocleanings@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sat 7:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sun closed
- Founded: 1989 as Express Mini Blind & Window Cleaning; family-owned since 1998
- Owner: Anna Piontkevych
- Languages: English, Ukrainian, Russian

## Services
- Window Cleaning Services — window, blind and screen cleaning; screen and blind repairs (/services/window-cleaning/)
- House Cleaning Services — deep cleaning, move-in/move-out, post-construction, recurring maintenance (/services/house-cleaning/)
- Gutter and Roof Cleaning — gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning (clean panels produce more), roof debris cleaning (/services/gutter-roof-cleaning/)
- Pressure / Soft Washing — house, roof, driveway, patio, porches, decks, fences (/services/pressure-washing/)
- Seasonal Services — Christmas light installation and takedown (/services/seasonal-services/)

## Not offered
- Carpet cleaning

## Service areas
Sacramento, North Highlands, Rio Linda, Citrus Heights, Carmichael, Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom
